li.label: callous
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is charming when it suits {PAWN_objective} and cold when it doesn't. Strangers' suffering means little to {PAWN_objective}, but {PAWN_pronoun} still cares about a small inner circle: family, lovers and the few people {PAWN_pronoun} truly rates. When stressed, the charm drops away.

li.label: sociopath
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is charming when it suits {PAWN_objective} and cold when it doesn't. Strangers' suffering means nothing to {PAWN_objective}, but {PAWN_pronoun} still cares about a small inner circle: family, lovers and the few people {PAWN_pronoun} truly rates. Anyone who hurts them becomes an enemy.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} remembers every slight three times as long and forgets kindness three times as fast. Events move {PAWN_possessive} mood less than other people's, but {PAWN_pronoun} gets bored without some excitement. {PAWN_pronoun} holds together in a fight and pays for it afterwards. When {PAWN_pronoun} breaks, {PAWN_pronoun} doesn't mope. {PAWN_pronoun} goes after whoever {PAWN_pronoun} holds a grudge against.
